en-US.description: A keyboard-first, dual-pane professional file manager with embedded terminals, an operation queue, and a plugin platform.
en-US.longDescription:
Cwdio File Manager is a keyboard-first, dual-pane file manager for Windows. It pairs an orthodox
two-pane workflow with embedded multi-session terminals (cwd-synced), a cancelable/resumable operation
queue, archive browse + write (ZIP/RAR/7z/tar), remote filesystems (SFTP/FTP/FTPS), rich previews
(PDF/media/code/hex), bulk rename, duplicate finding, and a plugin platform. Every feature is free —
there is no paid tier, no account and no telemetry.
en-US.name: Cwdio File Manager
